profile.size: Typically 2 to 5 lb and 8 to 14 in; up to about 34 in and 11 lb (NOAA Fisheries). Florida state record 8 lb 9 oz.
profile.range: North Carolina to southeastern Brazil; most abundant around the Bahamas, south Florida and the Caribbean
profile.behavior: Reef fish found around coral heads, patch reefs and high-profile artificial structure. Often swarms up a steady chum slick. Juveniles use seagrass and mangrove nursery habitat.
profile.spawning: April through August in the southeast U.S. (SAFMC); FishBase notes spawning occurs year-round in parts of the range with different peaks by area
profile.lifespan: 6 to 14 years typical; up to 28 years (NOAA Fisheries)
profile.depth: Adults mostly 10-70 m over sandy areas near offshore reefs (NOAA Fisheries); commercial handline catch mainly 20-60 m; overall depth range 0-180 m (FishBase). Juveniles use seagrass, mangroves and back reefs.

factors.value_notes: FWC and angling sources tie yellowtail to coral reefs, patch reefs and artificial wrecks. Structure comes from FWC's artificial reef list and the Unified Reef Map v2.2 (Jan 2025), limited to patch reef, aggregate reef, ridge and pavement. Rubble, scattered coral in sediment and seagrass are not counted. Juveniles use seagrass and mangroves (add a life_stage factor in v2).
factors.reason_template: This spot is a {value}, the kind of reef structure yellowtail hold on.

factors.value_notes: NOAA Fisheries: adults at 10-70 m near offshore reefs. SEDAR 8: commercial handline catch mainly 20-60 m. FishBase: 0-180 m overall. Cells shallower than 5 m are excluded (gate): that is bay and flat bottom, where juveniles live, not the reef water adults use. The 5 m cutoff is a judgment call, not a published figure.
factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, within the range yellowtail use on reefs.

factors.value_notes: FishBase model gives a preferred range of 21.7-27.9 C (mean 25.9). Reef Life Survey observations span 22.1-31.1 C.
factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, within yellowtail's comfortable range.

factors.value_notes: Anglers fish a steady-flowing chum slick, but no numeric current preference was found. Switched off until a source is found.
